title: A party is cleared by evidence, never his own pleading
text: A party is cleared by evidence and other voices, never by his own pleading (1109). Other voices stay when they explain the host's motive or the law, not when they vouch; about a person in custody, keep feelings and hedged readings, cut verdicts.

source.heading: Candidates from the overnight study (2026-11-23, none confirmed)

confirm: Where a party is cleared, by which evidence or voice, and is any self-pleading left?
